title: Cards Exposed
next_chapter_hook: In that instant, Chen Ji felt a chill run down his spine—someone was watching him. It wasn't Lin Xiao's hatred, nor the onlookers' astonishment, but a bone-penetrating, cold gaze that seemed to be examining prey.

text.content:
The oppressive force of the Beast Soul Seal descended like a physical weight, Chen Ji felt his chest tighten as if a thousand-pound boulder pressed against his heart. That jet-black mark on Lin Xiao's left arm squirmed slowly, emanating a nauseating aura of primal savagery—the bloodthirsty instinct unique to remnant souls of ancient fierce beasts.

"Waste, did you really think I would fight you fairly?" Lin Xiao's voice grew low and hoarse, his pupils flickering with beast-like ferocity. "Today, I will show everyone who the real ant is!"

Dust rose in the Martial Arena. The surrounding Outer Disciples retreated in fright, their faces pale. Once the Beast Soul Seal appeared, victory was decided—so everyone共识. Even the elders on the high platform frowned slightly, clearly not expecting Lin Xiao to harbor such a trump card.

Yet Chen Ji still stood in place, his expression calm.

dialogue.content:
(Looking at Lin Xiao calmly)... A fair battle?

(A slight curve forming at the corner of his mouth, an ambiguous arc)

You think you've already won?

text.content:
Before the words even finished, Lin Xiao had already moved.

"Beast Soul Impact!"

A jet-black pillar of light erupted from his left arm, carrying forces of destruction, aiming directly for Chen Ji's chest. The speed was astonishing—one blink and it had already arrived. This was a lethal strike sufficient to instantly kill any Outer Disciple!

The onlookers screamed in alarm. Some had already closed their eyes, unable to bear watching the bloody carnage about to unfold.

However, at this critical moment, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

His right hand had quietly reached into his bosom, touching that page of ancient manuscript.

The icy aura of the Tianji Record spread along his arm. Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a shock—

Scenes of the next three hours flashed through his mind like a carousel.

He "saw" Lin Xiao's attack trajectory: that jet-black pillar of light would suddenly fork three inches before his chest, because the Beast Soul Seal's power was unstable. He needed to shift half a step to the left, then strike from an improbable angle, cutting underneath to hit Lin Xiao's right flank—where the Beast Soul Seal connected to the meridian.

That was Lin Xiao's fatal weakness.

"Worth it."

Chen Ji silently calculated. Five points of Heavenly Fate for one life—good deal.

His body reacted faster than his consciousness.

dialogue.content:
(Shifting half a step to the left, movements fluid as if rehearsed a thousand times)

(Eyes blazing, staring directly at Lin Xiao's right flank)

...There.

text.content:
The jet-black pillar of light whistled past Chen Ji's sleeve, missing by a hair's breadth.

What?!

Lin Xiao's pupils contracted violently. He never imagined how this waste could possibly know the attack's trajectory in advance? That instant of evasion was too precise, too composed, as if Chen Ji had long seen through everything he could do.

But he had no time to think.

Because Chen Ji's counterattack had already arrived.

Chen Ji lowered his body like a cunning fox stalking prey. He didn't block head-on, didn't retreat. Instead, he struck from an uncanny angle—from Lin Xiao's blind spot in vision.

"Bone-Shattering Palm!"

One palm struck Lin Xiao's right flank.

This palm strike appeared ordinary on the surface, yet it concentrated all of Chen Ji's strength and speed. More terrifying was that he precisely struck the connection point between the Beast Soul Seal and the meridian—that flaw only the Tianji Record could foresee!

"Pfft!"

Lin Xiao spat blood, his entire body blasted backward. The Beast Soul Seal on his left arm trembled violently, the jet-black light flickering madly before finally dimming.

dialogue.content:
(Standing with hands behind back, robes fluttering, expression cold and indifferent)

...Beast Soul Seal?

(A light laugh, voice soft but clearly audible to everyone present)

That's all it is.

text.content:
The Martial Arena fell into deathly silence.

Everyone was stunned. Lin Xiao, the number one Outer Disciple, had revealed the Beast Soul Seal lost to the Xuanwu Sect for a thousand years, yet was defeated in one palm by a recognized waste?

How could this be?!

"How did he do it?"
"That palm... was clearly ordinary..."
"Waste? If he's waste, what does that make Lin Xiao?"

Whispers surged like a tide. Shock, confusion, disbelief—all sorts of emotions spread through the crowd.

At the edge of the crowd, a figure hidden in shadows suddenly narrowed their eyes.

dialogue.content:
(Eyes slightly narrowing, a playful arc forming at the corner of the mouth)

Interesting...

(Murmuring to himself)

That predictive ability... isn't ordinary combat instinct. What did he see in that instant?

text.content:
Ye Qing—the Holy Sect's Saint Maiden—was currently standing among the crowd in the guise of a Tianqing Sect visitor. She was Chen Ji's most important strategic ally, and the only person who knew part of his secrets.

But even she felt a trace of shock at this moment.

The aura of the Tianji Record. She sensed it.

That fleeting fluctuation of heavenly secret probing, though just a flash, was enough to alarm her. How much had this waste of a junior disciple been hiding?

Her gaze swept across the high platform to Elder Three, discovering that old man's expression had also changed—from carelessness to contemplative thought.

Trouble. Things were about to get complicated.

Above the platform, Elder Three slowly opened his eyes.

Those murky old eyes now gleamed sharply, as if capable of piercing through all falsehood. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying examination, inquiry, and a hint of... greed?

"This child..."

Elder Three stroked his flowery white beard, voice low: "Interesting."

Beside him, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao frowned slightly. She noticed Elder Three's changing expression, an inexplicable unease rising in her heart.

That waste of a junior brother... what secrets did he have?

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao is severely wounded and the Beast Soul Seal has failed. The onlookers are shocked, Elder Three has begun to pay attention to you. How will you respond to this sudden attention?

choices.text: Pretend weakness, retreat from the stage
choices.description: The overconsumption leads to exhaustion, taking this opportunity to leave everyone's sight and avoid further scrutiny.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to expand the victory
choices.visible_reward: Continue maintaining the waste persona to reduce the risk of investigation
choices.risk_hint: Elder Three has already noticed you; simple displays of weakness may not completely eliminate suspicion

text.content:
Chen Ji stumbled, his face showing a pale weakness. He braced against his knees, gasping as if that single palm had drained all his strength.

"I... I'll go back first..."

He murmured softly, his voice carrying恰到好处的 fatigue. The onlookers exchanged glances, though suspicious in their hearts, they couldn't find any flaws. After all, a waste winning was probably luck—luck so great it left him exhausted makes sense.

choices.text: Bow to Elder Three and take the initiative to express loyalty
choices.description: Seize the opportunity to show favor to Elder Three, expressing willingness to serve the sect, establishing a new patron through this momentum.
choices.visible_cost: May attract deeper attention and probing from Elder Three
choices.visible_reward: Gain recognition at the elder level, elevate status within the sect
choices.risk_hint: Elder Three's mind runs deep; proactively approaching may let the wolf into the house

text.content:
Chen Ji straightened his robes and bowed deeply to Elder Three on the high platform.

"Disciple Chen Ji, honored to fulfill the mission. This battle was entirely due to the sect's cultivation. Disciple is willing to give this body for the sect."

Elder Three narrowed his eyes, examining this waste disciple that everyone had ignored. After a long while, he nodded: "Not bad. Neither arrogant nor impatient. A cultivable talent."

While the words were so, the light in his eyes grew even deeper.

choices.text: Coldly sweep across the entire arena, intimidate the petty
choices.description: With a tough stance, warn those who had bullied him before, displaying strength not to be underestimated.
choices.visible_cost: Make more enemies, exposing that one is not content to endure in silence
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate potential enemies, greatly boost reputation
choices.risk_hint: Too high-profile will attract attention from more forces, including Elder Three and others observing in shadows

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze slowly sweeping across the arena. Those Outer Disciples who had coldly mocked him all lowered their heads, not daring to meet his eyes.

"Does anyone else think Chen Ji is waste?"

His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. No one responded.

A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He turned and left, his back solitary yet audacious.

After Chen Ji left the Martial Arena, he didn't return directly to the Servants' Quarters.

He turned into a quiet alley, confirmed no one was around, then leaned against the wall.

The backlash from Heavenly Fate consumption began to manifest—a wave of dizziness struck, his temples throbbing. But what concerned him more was the feeling from moments ago.

Something was watching him.

Not Lin Xiao's hatred, not the onlookers' astonishment. But a bone-penetrating, cold and profound gaze.

That was the gaze of a hunter watching prey.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, alarm bells ringing in his heart.

dialogue.content:
(Stepping out from the shadows, smile brilliant)

A splendid battle, junior brother.

(Lowering her voice)

Just now... you activated the Tianji Record, didn't you?

text.content:
Ye Qing's appearance didn't surprise Chen Ji. He'd long sensed the Holy Sect Saint Maiden's aura following behind him.

"The Tianji Record's aura is hard to conceal." Ye Qing approached several steps, eyes burning with intensity. "I can sense it because of my special cultivation technique. But if it were someone else..."

She didn't finish, but the meaning was clear.

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then spoke: "I know."

"You know?" Ye Qing raised an eyebrow. "Then what do you plan to do?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing asks about your plans. As each other's most important ally, how will you respond?

choices.description: Tell Ye Qing about Elder Three's reaction truthfully, jointly analyze the situation and formulate countermeasures.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more information about the Tianji Record to the ally
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust, deepen the alliance, obtain methods to mask aura using Holy Sect mists
choices.risk_hint: Allies can also become hidden dangers; information sharing means shared risks

text.content:
Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then laid out everything about Elder Three's changing expression.

After listening, Ye Qing's expression turned grave: "Elder Three... if he's the one who noticed you, things just got complicated."

She paused, lowering her voice: "I can teach you the basics of Holy Sect Mist to temporarily conceal the Tianji Record's aura. But long-term, you need a more secure solution."

choices.description: Only reveal part of the information, keeping allies ignorant of your core secrets.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Ye Qing's displeasure, affecting the alliance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage; don't let anyone fully understand your trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is intelligent; perfunctory responses may backfire

text.content:
"Rest assured, I have a plan."

Chen Ji said coolly, offering no further explanation.

Ye Qing frowned, clearly dissatisfied with his attitude. But she quickly suppressed her emotions, coldly harrumphed: "Fine, just as long as you know what you're doing. But I remind you, Elder Three won't let this go."

Before turning to leave, she tossed out: "Next time you use the Tianji Record, come find me first."

choices.description: Don't discuss the past, but act immediately, using Ye Qing's abilities to布置 countermeasures.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming Ye Qing's resources and connections
choices.visible_reward: Lay out defenses before enemies can react, turning passive into active
choices.risk_hint: Taking initiative may alert the enemy, or could play right into their trap

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes sharpened: "Since we've already been spotted, rather than waiting passively, let's take the initiative."

He quickly gave Ye Qing some instructions. After listening, a flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes: "You want me to spread false information?"

"Not just that." A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "I want to make Elder Three think his target is someone else entirely."

Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then laughed softly: "Getting more interesting, Chen Ji junior brother."

After sending Ye Qing away, Chen Ji stood alone in the alley.

The setting sun slanted westward, stretching his shadow long. He closed his eyes, recalling the visions he saw when using the Tianji Record—

Lin Xiao's attack trajectory, the Beast Soul Seal's flaw, the critical strike that decided victory in one palm.

But besides these, there was also a blurry image.

That was a room, dimly lit. Someone sat in the shadows, before them lay a chess game. The pieces... seemed alive, writhing on the board.

What was that?

Chen Ji frowned deeply. The Tianji Record's visions of the future never appeared without reason. What did that image mean?

dialogue.content:
(A voice ancient and distant echoing in the mind)

"Have you sensed it, Successor?"

That was Mo Xiansheng's voice—the remnant soul guardian of the Tianji Record's first page.

"Every time you use the Tianji Record, you draw closer to the truth. But truth... is often more dangerous than fate itself."

(The voice gradually fades)

"Remember, chess player and chess piece—only a thought apart."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's words were like a basin of cold water, waking Chen Ji from his momentary victory.

Yes, he won a battle. But behind this battle, how many eyes were watching? Elder Three, the person in that blurry image, and... beings from even higher?

The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash.

This was a warning he knew long ago.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, raising his head to gaze at the blood-red evening clouds on the horizon. His gaze gradually grew firm.

"Since I've already been spotted, there's no need to hide anymore."

He murmured to himself, his voice carrying a trace of resolve: "Let them watch. Let's see in this chess game, who is the chess player, and who is merely the piece."

The evening breeze brushed past, bringing a chill.

And on the rooftop not far behind Chen Ji, a pair of cold eyes watched his retreating figure. That gaze held examination, amusement, and a certain indescribable... anticipation?
